Description: Village Sentinel review draft: one SSM-only host and a four-hour stop timer. Application installation and live inference are separate. Not yet validated in AWS.

VpcId.Description: Existing VPC with DNS and internet egress

SubnetId.Description: Existing public subnet in the selected VPC, with an internet route

AmiId.Description: Reviewed Ubuntu 24.04 x86_64 AMI in this region, with SSM agent installed

InstanceType.Description: CPU candidate only; verify quota, rate <= $0.25/hour and actual model feasibility first

BedrockResourceArns.Description: Exact reviewed inference-profile and destination foundation-model ARNs; do not supply a wildcard

Properties.GroupDescription: No inbound network access; connect through SSM

UserData.Fn::Base64:
#!/bin/bash
set -eu
cat >/etc/systemd/system/sentinel-autostop.service <<'UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=Stop the approved demo session
[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/sbin/poweroff
UNIT
cat >/etc/systemd/system/sentinel-autostop.timer <<'UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=Four-hour demo limit
[Timer]
OnBootSec=4h
Unit=sentinel-autostop.service
[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
UNIT
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable --now sentinel-autostop.timer

Access.Value: SSM only; forward remote port 5173 after application setup. No public web endpoint is created.

CostReminder.Value: Confirm EC2 is stopped after each session. Storage still costs money while stopped. Export evidence before terminating.
